status: completed exploratory prototype with visible unresolved defects
construction: Ordinary Blender Python; elliptical four-panel open torso shell with separately editable sleeve lofts, lapels, back collar, tabs, waist belt, cuff assemblies, piping curves, metal buckle frames and individual chain-link meshes. No imported or generated external geometry.

Disabled denoising, then rendered the initial front/back/three-quarter views.
One geometry/material correction; preserved initial artifacts; saved corrected candidate and GLB; rendered all three views.
Saved independent 70 mm cuff revision, verified protected objects and materials, reopened the candidate, and saved restored.blend.

reference_interpretation.decorated_side: wearer left (+X), following front/back/labelled left. Unlabelled and conflicting oblique decoration is not duplicated.
reference_interpretation.chest_and_hem: 90 cm chest and 68 cm hem are interpreted as closed circumferences. The open front is not directly measurable as a closed loop. Nominal closed construction ellipses give 0.8996 m chest and 0.6874 m hem before the open wedge is removed.
reference_interpretation.cuff: G=13 cm is treated as approximately 26 cm around. The nominal cuff base ellipse is about 26.1 cm around; this is a construction parameter, not a measured closed inner cuff circumference. N=13 cm is unresolved and not enforced.
reference_interpretation.collar: I=7.5 cm is ambiguous; not imposed as the entire neck opening. Stand height is approximately 3.1 cm.
reference_interpretation.scale: Metres, Z up, front -Y, wearer left +X; rear-center body control hem is at X=0,Z=0.

unresolved_visible_defects: The sleeve/armscye transitions retain pinching and small triangular surface intersections, particularly visible from the back and at the front upper arms. They are not production-clean sewn joins.

Upper cuff piping and part of the buckle strap intersect the main sleeve on their front faces. The local height edit is geometrically verified but does not fix this pre-existing overlap; the close-up images make the limitation visible.
The lapels are more angular and planar than the softly rolled reference, and the uniform-height back collar is less naturally folded.
The shoulder tabs remain thin with some visible separation. The simplified shield has a rigid patch silhouette, and small fleur-de-lis detail, chains and pendants are approximations.
Sleeve fold distribution is procedural and comparatively smooth; no garment simulation or sewing-pattern fit was performed.

The three-quarter render clearly shows the open front, neck, waist and cuffs, but resemblance is a visual prototype assessment only. No calibrated photo matching or numerical similarity score was produced.
runtime_friction: OpenImageDenoise unavailable in the local Blender binary; disabled denoising and retained failure log.
validation_limits: No cloth simulation, rigging, engine integration, watertightness certification or production topology acceptance.
Geometry/transform/curve fingerprints and shader input hashes support the local edit checks, not perceptual similarity.
Exact model-token usage is unavailable and was not estimated.
